subtitle.zh: 10 天理解 DDP、FSDP2 与可恢复训练
subtitle.en: Understand DDP, FSDP2 and recoverable training in 10 days

description.zh: 从单进程基线扩展到多进程数据并行，理解通信、采样、性能与检查点，再为 FSDP2 建立正确的内存与执行模型。用小模型训练工程验证方法，不以大模型或大集群作为入门门槛。 每日补充图解、可运行CPU实验、预期输出、排错和解析题；保留真实框架选做路线。
description.en: Grow a single-process baseline into multi-process data-parallel training. Study communication, sampling, performance and checkpointing, then build the correct memory/execution model for FSDP2. Validate ideas with a small training project instead of requiring a large model or cluster. Every day includes diagrams, runnable CPU exercises, expected outputs, troubleshooting and explained quizzes, with an optional real-framework path.

hoursPerDay.en: 120–180 minutes a day; about 20–30 hours total

prerequisites.zh: 能够写出并解释单机 PyTorch 的 forward、loss、backward 和 optimizer.step；理解张量、梯度与基本进程概念。
prerequisites.en: Write and explain a single-device PyTorch forward/loss/backward/optimizer loop. Understand tensors, gradients and basic processes.

hardware.zh: 普通电脑可完成Python 3.9+标准库的数值/系统语义实验；真实框架路线见实验包README，须另备对应环境。CPU模型与GPU实测分开标记。
hardware.en: A laptop runs Python 3.9+ standard-library numerical/system exercises. Optional real-framework routes require the environment in the lab README. Label CPU models and hardware measurements separately.

zh: 训练框架工程师
分布式训练工程师

en: Training framework engineer
Distributed training engineer
AI platform engineer

outcome.zh: 一个能验证数据覆盖、训练一致性与恢复流程的小型分布式训练仓库，以及 DDP/FSDP2 选型与容量分析。
outcome.en: A small distributed-training repository with data-coverage, training-consistency and recovery checks, plus a DDP/FSDP2 selection and capacity analysis.

title.zh: 保存一个可信的单进程基线

lesson.zh: 分布式训练首先要保持训练语义。没有稳定的单进程基线，就无法判断差异来自通信、数据划分还是原来的模型代码。固定小数据集、初始化、损失定义和优化器，记录每一步处理了哪些样本。种子只是复现信息的一部分，算子、平台和版本也会影响确定性；不要要求不适合的场景达到逐 bit 相同。
lesson.en: Distributed training must preserve the intended training semantics. Without a single-process baseline, differences cannot be attributed to communication, data partitioning or preexisting model code. Fix a small dataset, initialization, loss definition and optimizer, and record which samples each step consumes. Seeds are only part of reproducibility: operations, platforms and versions also matter, so bitwise equality is not always an appropriate target.

task.zh: 手算前两步，再将初始weight改为1，解释轨迹为何不同。
task.en: Hand-calculate two updates, change the starting weight to one and explain the trajectory.

body.zh: 模型y=wx，样本x=[1,2]、y=[2,4]，损失用均方误差，梯度为mean(2x(wx−y))。w=0时梯度−10，学习率0.1让第一次更新得到w=1。先把这个单进程答案算清，再比较分布式。
body.en: For y=wx with x=[1,2], targets=[2,4] and mean squared error, the gradient is mean(2x(wx−y)). At w=0 it is −10; learning rate .1 yields w=1 after one update. Establish this scalar reference before distribution.

body.en: Four updates produce 1, 1.5, 1.75 and 1.875. Saving gradients and steps identifies the first divergence. This is scalar Python, not autograd, DDP communication or measured training throughput.

title.zh: 理解 rank、进程组与集体通信
title.en: Understand ranks, process groups and collectives

lesson.zh: rank 是进程在通信组内的身份，world size 是组内进程数，local rank 通常用于映射本机设备。集体通信要求参与进程以兼容的顺序调用对应操作，张量形状和类型也必须匹配。all-reduce、all-gather 和 reduce-scatter 解决不同数据交换需求。先用小张量验证语义，可以避免把进程协调错误误认为网络性能问题。
lesson.en: A rank identifies a process within a communication group, world size counts its processes, and local rank commonly maps processes to local devices. Collectives require participating processes to call compatible operations in the same order, with matching tensor expectations. All-reduce, all-gather and reduce-scatter serve different exchange patterns. Small tensor examples help distinguish coordination bugs from network-performance problems.

title.en: Rank is not a thread index

body.zh: world_size是进程组成员数，rank是组内身份。真实torchrun会设置RANK、LOCAL_RANK和WORLD_SIZE。若某个rank遗漏或以不同顺序进入通信，其他rank可能等待，必须以超时与日志定位。
body.en: world_size counts process-group members; rank identifies a member. torchrun sets RANK, LOCAL_RANK and WORLD_SIZE. Missing or differently ordered collective participation can make peers wait; use timeouts and logs.

options.zh: 当前节点内的进程序号

explanation.zh: 它用于节点内资源映射，不是global rank的别名。
explanation.en: It maps node-local resources and need not equal global rank.

title.zh: 把单机训练改造成 DDP

lesson.zh: DDP 复制模型并同步梯度，但不会自动为你划分输入数据。各 rank 计算自己的 loss，再通过同步得到用于更新的梯度；若每个 rank 的样本数或 loss 权重不同，简单平均可能不再等价于预期的全局目标。比较单进程和 DDP 时，应保持有效全局 batch、初始化与优化器语义一致，而不是只比较每个进程的 batch size。
lesson.en: DDP replicates a model and synchronizes gradients; it does not automatically partition your input data. Each rank computes a local loss and participates in gradient synchronization. Unequal sample counts or loss weights can make a simple average differ from the intended global objective. Compare single-process and DDP runs with equivalent effective global batch, initialization and optimizer semantics, not merely equal per-process batch sizes.

body.zh: 两个rank分别处理x=1和x=2，局部平均梯度为−4和−16。DDP默认平均梯度得到−10，与单进程全局均值一致。这个等价依赖相同模型初值、损失定义及每rank样本数。
body.en: Ranks processing x=1 and x=2 have local mean gradients −4 and −16. Default DDP averaging gives −10, matching the global mean. Equivalence depends on common initial parameters, loss definition and equal local batch sizes.

title.zh: 不等批量需要样本权重

body.zh: 局部均值2和8、样本数3和1，全局样本均值应为(2×3+8×1)/4=3.5；简单rank平均为5。独立挑战weighted_gradient要求你正确合并，并拒绝空输入和零样本数。
body.en: Local means two and eight with sample counts three and one combine to 3.5; a rank mean would be five. Implement weighted_gradient and reject empty input or zero counts.

title.zh: 验证数据覆盖与每轮采样
title.en: Verify data coverage and epoch sampling

lesson.zh: 数据并行不仅关乎通信，还关乎每个样本被谁看到。DistributedSampler 可以为 rank 划分索引，但数据量不能整除时可能补齐或丢弃；DataLoader 的 drop_last 又作用于批次，两层行为需要分开。每轮正确更新采样 epoch 才能得到预期的重新打乱。训练看似正常下降并不证明数据没有重复、遗漏或排序错误。
lesson.en: Data parallelism also determines who sees each sample. DistributedSampler partitions indices, but nondivisible dataset sizes may require padding or dropping examples. DataLoader's drop_last acts at the batch level and is a separate decision. Updating the sampler epoch enables the intended reshuffling. A decreasing training loss does not prove that samples are neither duplicated nor omitted, or that ordering is correct.

title.zh: 平均分配会补齐或丢弃

body.zh: 5个样本分给2个rank，补齐策略产生6次样本访问，至少一个重复；drop策略只访问4个样本，少一个。不要同时声称每rank等长、没有重复、没有丢弃，除非数据量可整除。
body.en: Five samples across two ranks cannot all be equal-length, unique and complete. Padding produces six visits with a duplicate; dropping uses four and omits one. Exact coverage requires handling this tradeoff.

body.zh: 实验用epoch作为确定性随机种子，同一epoch复现同一顺序，改变epoch应换顺序。真实DistributedSampler需要在每轮调用set_epoch。验证样本ID覆盖，不只看loader的batch数量。
body.en: The model seeds shuffling by epoch: same epoch reproduces order, a new epoch changes it. Real DistributedSampler needs set_epoch each epoch. Audit sample IDs rather than only loader lengths.

question.en: Padded visits for five samples on two ranks?

explanation.en: Three per rank gives six visits, including repetition.

question.zh: 只看每rank长度能验证完整覆盖吗？
question.en: Do shard lengths prove complete coverage?

explanation.zh: 长度不能揭示重复或遗漏。
explanation.en: Lengths do not reveal duplicates or omissions.

lesson.zh: 启动器负责建立进程环境，但不会修复训练代码中的同步不一致。一个 rank 提前退出、跳过 backward 或等待不同数据，都可能让其他进程停在集体通信。排障应记录 rank、步骤和通信边界，先判断是否所有进程走到同一位置，再排查网络。调大超时可能掩盖错误，应先解释为什么某个进程没有按预期参与。
lesson.en: A launcher establishes process environments but cannot fix inconsistent synchronization in training code. A rank that exits early, skips backward or waits for different input may leave peers blocked in a collective. Log ranks, steps and synchronization boundaries, checking whether every process reaches the same stage before blaming networking. A longer timeout can conceal a bug; first explain why a process failed to participate.

title.zh: 保持梯度累积与精度语义一致

lesson.zh: 梯度累积用多个 microbatch 构成一次更新，影响有效 batch 和同步频率。若希望与一个大 batch 等价，需要处理 loss 缩放、清零时机和最后一次同步；DDP 的 no_sync 使用边界也必须符合官方约定。混合精度另有溢出、累加与缩放问题。先验证等效更新，再研究通信减少，不能把语义变化造成的差异误称为纯性能优化。
lesson.en: Gradient accumulation combines microbatches into one update, changing effective batch and synchronization frequency. Equivalence to a larger batch requires correct loss scaling, zeroing and final synchronization, including DDP's documented no_sync boundaries. Mixed precision introduces separate overflow and scaling concerns. Validate equivalent updates before investigating communication savings so that altered optimization semantics are not presented as a pure performance improvement.

title.zh: 观察通信、计算与扩展效率

lesson.zh: 总训练时间由数据准备、计算、通信和等待共同决定。部分通信可能与反向计算重叠，所以把所有事件时长直接相加会高估总时间。扩展比较要说明固定的是全局 batch 还是每卡 batch，并使用实际处理样本数计算吞吐。两卡比单卡快不意味着多机线性加速；网络拓扑与小模型调度开销都会改变结果。
lesson.en: Training time includes input work, computation, communication and waiting. Communication may overlap backward computation, so summing every event duration can overestimate elapsed time. Scaling comparisons must state whether global or per-device batch is fixed and calculate throughput from actual processed samples. A two-device improvement does not imply linear multi-node scaling; topology and small-model overhead can substantially change the result.

title.zh: 理解 FSDP2 的分片与临时聚合
title.en: Understand FSDP2 sharding and temporary gathering

lesson.zh: 当模型状态无法经济地复制到每张卡，分片可以减少常驻内存。FSDP2 通过 fully_shard 管理参数、梯度和优化器状态的分布，在计算需要时收集参数，再按策略释放完整副本。较小的分片单元可能降低峰值内存，却增加通信调度成本。新代码应参考 FSDP2 接口，不能把旧版 FSDP1 的示例无条件混用。
lesson.en: When replicating model state on every device is impractical, sharding can reduce resident memory. FSDP2 uses fully_shard to manage distributed parameters, gradients and optimizer state, gathering parameters for computation and releasing full copies according to policy. Smaller sharding units may lower peak memory while increasing communication overhead. New code should follow FSDP2 guidance rather than freely mixing older FSDP1 examples and interfaces.

title.zh: 交付一个可恢复的训练工程

lesson.zh: 一个合格的小型分布式作品应证明数据覆盖、梯度语义、故障处理和恢复，而不仅是打印多个 rank。用明确的工作负载解释为何选择 DDP 或 FSDP2，并指出何时才需要张量或流水线并行。大规模训练的网络、容错与成本优化仍需后续实战；本路线的目标是建立可以审查的基础工程证据。
lesson.en: A strong small distributed-training project demonstrates data coverage, gradient semantics, failure handling and recovery rather than merely printing multiple ranks. Explain the choice of DDP or FSDP2 for a specific workload and identify when tensor or pipeline parallelism would become relevant. Large-scale networking, resilience and cost optimization need further practice. This path establishes reviewable engineering foundations rather than cluster-scale expertise.

task.en: Fill personal contributions and one failure case; have a peer recompute gradients and resume results.

noGpu.zh: 完整CPU路线不需要GPU：下载实验包并运行lab.py。真实框架脚本是选做；未运行时请保留待验证标签，不能把模型毫秒值写成GPU性能。
noGpu.en: The complete CPU path needs no GPU: download the pack and run lab.py. Real-framework scripts are optional; mark unrun work pending and do not label model times as GPU performance.

body.zh: 作品应串起单rank参考、等批量平均、不等批量权重、样本覆盖和恢复。每个结论指向一份JSON或自己的函数测试。真实DDP可选例只验证一次同步更新，不证明长期训练质量。
body.en: Connect the single-rank reference, equal/unequal batch weighting, sample coverage and resume. Link claims to JSON or your own tests. The optional DDP example checks one synchronized update, not long-run training quality.

body.zh: day10生成九天原始数据和报告骨架。CPU代数、真实Gloo、GPU NCCL应分别标记；没装torch也能交付CPU分析作品，但不能自称已完成DDP或FSDP生产验证。
body.en: day10 emits nine daily data files and a report scaffold. Label CPU algebra, actual Gloo and GPU NCCL separately. A CPU analysis portfolio is valid without torch, but is not DDP/FSDP production validation.
